name: Marshall Headphones
description: Consumer audio brand from Stockholm-based Marshall Group (formerly Zound Industries) that carries the Marshall amplifier heritage into headphones, earbuds and home speakers, sold direct through marshallheadphones.com in more than 90 countries.

evidence.summary: Lasso's programme listing states the Marshall Headphones affiliate programme pays 5% per sale with a 45-day cookie window, in the electronics category.
LinkClicky's programme directory lists Marshall Headphones on the CJ Affiliate platform at 5% per sale, with marshallheadphones.com as the brand website.

Marshall Group's own release confirms the consumer headphones and speakers business is run by the Stockholm-headquartered group formed from Zound Industries and Marshall Amplification. No earnings-cap statement appears in any fetched source, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown rather than assumed uncapped.

reasons.niche_fit: Premium headphones and speakers are core creator-review territory in consumer tech.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Two independent programme listings confirm an open affiliate programme creators can join.
reasons.compensation: Published 5% per sale on high-ticket audio gear is workable but not generous.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email surfaced; contact runs through the CJ application.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through CJ Affiliate with a 45-day cookie.
reasons.credibility: Iconic global audio brand owned by Marshall Group of Stockholm.

name: ZAGG
description: Utah-founded mobile accessories company behind InvisibleShield screen protection, ZAGG cases and keyboards and mophie power products, sold direct at zagg.com.

evidence.summary: ZAGG's Awin merchant profile (ZAGG EU programme) states a 6% commission, a 30-day cookie and a 2025 average order value of 37 EUR; the profile confirms ZAGG began in Utah selling InvisibleShield screen protectors, cases, keyboards and power products.
Lasso's US listing reports a 6-10% per-sale range with a 30-day cookie, consistent with a 6% base rate. No earnings cap is stated in either source, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Phone cases, screen protection and charging gear are staple tech-creator categories.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A live Awin merchant profile confirms an open, joinable programme.
reasons.compensation: 6% base on accessories with a reported range up to 10% is mid-tier but real.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email surfaced; contact runs through Awin.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through the Awin merchant profile with a 30-day cookie.
reasons.credibility: Long-established US accessories brand with global retail distribution.

name: AV Access
description: Pro-AV manufacturer founded in 2015 in Zhejiang, China, selling KVM docking stations, HDMI and KVM extenders, switches and AV-over-IP products direct at avaccess.com to home-office and hybrid-work buyers.

evidence.summary: AV Access's own affiliate programme page publishes tiered commissions - 10% on the first $4,999 of annual referred sales, 12% up to $19,999, 14% up to $49,999 and 16-18% above $50,000 - and routes applications through Awin. No earnings-cap statement appears on the page, so the cap is recorded as unknown.
Crunchbase profiles AV Access as a professional Pro-AV and smart home-office device manufacturer headquartered in Zhejiang, China, and lists the contact email info@avaccess.com.

reasons.niche_fit: KVM docks and desk-setup gear fit the growing tech and home-office creator niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs a dedicated affiliate page actively recruiting partners through Awin.
reasons.compensation: 10% base rising to 18% on published tiers is strong for consumer electronics.
reasons.contact_access: A public contact email is published via the company's Crunchbase profile.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through the brand's own affiliate page into Awin.
reasons.credibility: Established 2015 manufacturer selling globally, though less of a household name.

name: OtterBox
description: Otter Products' mobile accessories brand, best known for Defender and Symmetry protective phone cases and MagSafe accessories, sold direct at otterbox.com and through global retail.

evidence.summary: Lasso's programme listing and its phone-accessory roundups place OtterBox's current US affiliate programme on Impact at 8% per sale with a 30-day cookie, noting approval requires an active content site rather than coupon-only or social-only channels.

Other fetched sources conflict: an Awin merchant profile for OtterBox FR lists 7% as the default rate, and a mirrored copy of OtterBox's older programme page describes a Commission Junction programme at 10%. Because the current rate cannot be settled from published sources, commission_rate is left null.

reasons.niche_fit: Protective phone cases are one of the most-reviewed accessories in tech content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A current programme listing confirms an open Impact programme for content publishers.
reasons.compensation: The programme pays per sale, but published rates conflict (7-10%), so compensation is scored cautiously with the rate left null.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email surfaced; contact runs through Impact.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Impact, with content-site approval requirements.
reasons.credibility: Category-defining US case brand with worldwide retail presence.

name: kin+kind
description: Natural pet grooming and wellness brand (To Doggy With Love LLC) founded in 2015 and based in Roselle, New Jersey, selling plant-powered shampoos, coat sprays, flea and tick products and supplements for dogs and cats, hand-mixed in the USA.

evidence.summary: kin+kind's own published Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions confirm an open affiliate programme run by To Doggy With Love LLC: affiliates earn referral fees on new-customer orders of all products (excluding gift cards, repeat-delivery purchases and donations), tracked through the programme platform.

CB Insights profiles kin+kind as founded in 2015 and headquartered in Roselle, New Jersey, specialising in grooming products and wellness supplements for pets.
